summary.text: Mike Chippendale is a Republican state representative who has represented District 40 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has been House minority leader since January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Chippendale, also known as Chip, was born in Providence, Rhode Island.

He earned an associate degree from the New England Institute of Technology and a bachelor's degree from Johnson & Wales University, and his career experience includes working in consulting, engineering and manufacturing.
He has been affiliated with the Muscular Dystrophy Association, Eastern States Exposition, the Foster Republican Town Committee and the Highland Rod and Gun Club.
